title: Bind header + My Profile display strictly to Firestore users/{uid} (name/email/photoURL) with server-fresh reads

requirements.summary: Render My Profile photo, full name, and email by reading only Firestore users/{auth.uid} fields photoURL/name/email (no Firebase Auth display binding) and avoid any Firestore writes during render.
acceptanceCriteria: When an authenticated user navigates to `/profile`, the UI displays `users/{uid}.name` and `users/{uid}.email` values from Firestore.
When `users/{uid}.photoURL` is a non-empty string, the profile avatar image uses that URL (no Firebase Auth `photoURL` is used).
No Firestore writes occur as part of rendering My Profile (no mutation/rename/backfill of stored data).

file_operations.description: Ensure all displayed profile fields (avatar image, full name, email) bind strictly to the Firestore-backed `userProfile.photoURL`, `userProfile.name`, and `userProfile.email` values returned from `useFirestoreUserProfile`, with no fallback to Firebase Auth user fields. Use existing shadcn-ui components (Avatar/Card/Badge/Separator) for rendering; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Confirm the profile query reads only by `authUser.uid` (Firestore doc users/{uid}) and returns the Firestore document data for display (no Firebase Auth field mapping). Keep the hook read-only (no create/update/backfill behavior).

requirements.summary: Implement deterministic avatar fallback on My Profile derived from Firestore name when Firestore photoURL is missing/empty/whitespace (do not attempt an image URL in that case).
acceptanceCriteria: If `photoURL` is empty or whitespace, the AvatarImage is not attempted/used and the AvatarFallback shows initials derived from the Firestore `name`.
If Firestore `name` is present, initials are stable and derived from that value (not from Firebase Auth).

file_operations.description: Adjust avatar rendering so `AvatarImage` is only rendered when Firestore `photoURL` is non-empty after trimming, otherwise render initials computed from Firestore `name` in `AvatarFallback`. Use the shadcn-ui Avatar component to provide the image/fallback behavior; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Fix header avatar + header/profile-menu name to render strictly from Firestore users/{uid}: use Firestore photoURL when present, otherwise initials from Firestore name, and display name exactly from Firestore name.
acceptanceCriteria: When a user is logged in and `users/{uid}` exists, the header avatar uses Firestore `photoURL` if non-empty; otherwise shows initials derived from Firestore `name`.
The header/profile dropdown displays the user’s name from Firestore `users/{uid}.name` (no Firebase Auth display name/email is used for display).
No changes are made to routes/pages outside the header components and My Profile screen.

file_operations.description: Ensure the header avatar uses only Firestore-backed `userProfile.photoURL` and `userProfile.name` from `useFirestoreUserProfile`, with conditional rendering to avoid attempting `AvatarImage` when `photoURL` is empty/whitespace, and initials derived from Firestore `name`. Use the shadcn-ui Avatar component for avatar UI; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the displayed name in the dropdown label is exactly the Firestore-backed `userProfile.name` passed from the header/profile hook and that no Firebase Auth user fields are used for display. Use existing shadcn-ui DropdownMenu components for the menu UI; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Verify profile reads target exact Firestore path users/{auth.uid} with awaited fresh server reads (no cache) and add/keep console logs confirming UID and non-cached read behavior for header + profile display.
acceptanceCriteria: Browser console shows a log indicating a Firestore fetch for the current auth UID (e.g., includes the UID used).
The profile fetch uses a fresh server read (not a cached-only read), and logs demonstrate the read is not from cache.
Header and My Profile update to show Firestore-backed values after the profile query resolves (no permanent blank state when data exists).

file_operations.description: Add/keep console logging in the query function to print the current `authUser.uid` used for the Firestore read, and confirm the fetch is awaited before resolving data to UI. Ensure the hook continues to rely on the existing Firestore server-fresh read behavior (no cache-only reads) provided by the Firebase helper.

Retain and, if needed, clarify console logs in the Firestore profile read helper to show the UID, that a server-fresh read is used, and the returned snapshot metadata indicating whether data came from cache. Ensure the read continues to target `users/{uid}` and uses an awaited server read.
